summary: Frontend-only verification of Google Play Photo Picker compliance fix. Static checks of /app/frontend/app.json all pass: android.permissions=[CAMERA, POST_NOTIFICATIONS, SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM] (no READ_MEDIA_IMAGES / READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE); blockedPermissions correctly lists READ_MEDIA_IMAGES, READ_MEDIA_VIDEO, READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE, WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE; expo-image-picker plugin has photosPermission:false and cameraPermission set; android.versionCode=2; expo.version=1.0.1; ios.buildNumber='2'; NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription removed from ios.infoPlist (only NSCameraUsageDescription remains). Code check of /app/frontend/app/animal-form.tsx confirms no runtime call to requestMediaLibraryPermissionsAsync in the library path (only a comment) — launchImageLibraryAsync is called directly (native Photo Picker). Camera path still gates on requestCameraPermissionsAsync as required. Runtime smoke test on mobile viewport 390x844 via preview URL: app loads (title 'Zootic'), no red-screen error, RTL Arabic UI works, Animals tab FAB opens the animal-form modal, 'المعرض' (pick-library) and 'الكاميرا' (pick-camera) buttons are present, tappable and do not crash on web (native picker no-ops), Save button persists animal 'بيسي/قطة' → animal card renders on grid, Meals tab add-meal-fab is present. All acceptance criteria from the review request are satisfied.

issues: Pre-existing warnings (non-blocking, unrelated to this fix): 'shadow*' style props deprecated → use boxShadow; Image style.resizeMode deprecated → use props.resizeMode.

react_native_issues.issue: Runtime warning: 'ImagePicker.MediaTypeOptions have been deprecated. Use ImagePicker.MediaType or an array of ImagePicker.MediaType instead.' Reference: /app/frontend/app/animal-form.tsx:87 (mediaTypes: ImagePicker.MediaTypeOptions.Images). Not a blocker for this fix, but should be migrated to keep future SDKs working.

action_items: Optional: migrate animal-form.tsx line 87 from ImagePicker.MediaTypeOptions.Images to ImagePicker.MediaType.Images (or ['images']) to silence deprecation warning.
Optional (carried from iteration_1, unrelated to this fix): replace deprecated shadow* style props with boxShadow, and move Image resizeMode from style to props.
critical_code_review_comments: app.json permission surface is now Play-policy compliant: READ_MEDIA_IMAGES/READ_MEDIA_VIDEO/READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE/WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE are all blocked and expo-image-picker.photosPermission:false prevents the plugin from re-merging them.

animal-form.tsx correctly implements native Photo Picker: launchImageLibraryAsync is called without any prior requestMediaLibraryPermissionsAsync call; camera path retains its permission gate as intended.
Version bumps (Android versionCode 2, iOS buildNumber '2', expo.version 1.0.1) applied correctly.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for the compliance fix — all 12 verification points pass
